framing: One packet per inbound frame: [seq][class][packet][body]. A frame carries at most the link's payload (BLE: MTU - 3); split batch records over several packets.
response: Every packet is answered on the response stream (contracts.generated.json response_stream) with status only: no OK data.

VM_BLOCK_NO_ID.description: Unwired input pin, or no ENO object.

VM_OBJ_NAME_MAX.description: Longest object or accessor name, in bytes.

VM_OBJ_HEAD_WIRE_SIZE.description: Bytes of vm_obj_head_t on the wire.

VM_OBJ_PTR_WIRE_SIZE.description: Bytes of one PTR element on the wire (a child object ID).

VM_OBJ_ID_NONE.description: No object (an unlinked PTR element on the wire).

VM_OBJ_ID_DYN_BIT.description: Set in the ID of a heap object (CLONE's copies); program object IDs stay below it.

CONFIG_VM_EXEC_TASK_PRIO.title: Supervisor task priority
CONFIG_VM_EXEC_TASK_PRIO.help: FreeRTOS task priority for the VM execution supervisor.

CONFIG_VM_EXEC_TASK_CORE.title: Supervisor task pinned core
CONFIG_VM_EXEC_TASK_CORE.help: Core affinity for VM supervisor task (default 1 to keep core 0 free for BLE).

CONFIG_VM_EXEC_MAX_SPAN_DEPTH.title: Maximum nested execution span depth
CONFIG_VM_EXEC_MAX_SPAN_DEPTH.help: Maximum nested loop/span depth allowed during block execution.

CONFIG_VM_EXEC_BLOCK_WD_MS.title: Block watchdog timeout (ms)
CONFIG_VM_EXEC_BLOCK_WD_MS.help: Maximum duration in milliseconds a single block may execute before timing out.

CONFIG_VM_EVENT_DEPTH.title: VM incoming event queue depth
CONFIG_VM_EVENT_DEPTH.help: Capacity of the ring buffer receiving events between cycles.

CONFIG_VM_OVERRIDE_BUF_SIZE.title: VM variable override ring buffer size (bytes)
CONFIG_VM_OVERRIDE_BUF_SIZE.help: Byte capacity of the runtime variable override ring buffer.

CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_PERIOD_S.title: Save period (s)
CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_PERIOD_S.help: How often the values of retentive objects are saved to flash, if any changed. Also saved on program teardown and on the safe state; an unplanned power loss loses at most one period.

CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_MAX_BYTES.title: Maximum retained bytes
CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_MAX_BYTES.help: Size of the stored record (2 + per object: 4 + name + value). A program retaining more is refused at load (ERR_VM_RETAIN_TOO_BIG). Costs twice this in RAM.

CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_TASK_STACK.title: Retain task stack (bytes)
CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_TASK_STACK.help: Stack of the low-priority task that writes retained values to flash, off the VM task.

CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_TASK_PRIO.title: Retain task priority
CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_TASK_PRIO.help: Priority of the retain task; below the VM supervisor.

CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_IN.title: Maximum input accessors per block
CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_IN.help: Maximum number of input accessors allowed for a single VM execution block.

CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_OUT.title: Maximum output objects per block
CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_OUT.help: Maximum number of output objects allowed for a single VM execution block.

CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_EN.title: Maximum enable accessors per block
CONFIG_VM_BLOCK_MAX_EN.help: Maximum number of enable accessors allowed for a single VM execution block.

CONFIG_VM_STORE_MAX_POOL.title: Maximum program arena pool size (bytes)
CONFIG_VM_STORE_MAX_POOL.help: Hard ceiling in bytes for the bump-allocated program storage arena.

CONFIG_VM_ACCESSOR_MAX_DEPTH.title: Maximum accessor path resolution depth
CONFIG_VM_ACCESSOR_MAX_DEPTH.help: Maximum chain depth when resolving nested accessor paths.

CONFIG_VM_OBJ_COPY_MAX_DEPTH.title: Maximum object copy recursion depth
CONFIG_VM_OBJ_COPY_MAX_DEPTH.help: Maximum tree recursion depth allowed when copying objects.

CONFIG_VM_DYN_MAX.title: Maximum concurrent dynamic objects
CONFIG_VM_DYN_MAX.help: Upper ceiling of live dynamically registered objects on the heap.

CONFIG_VM_DYN_MAX_DEPTH.title: Maximum dynamic DAG ownership depth
CONFIG_VM_DYN_MAX_DEPTH.help: Maximum allowed ownership path depth in dynamic object graph.

CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_SUBSCRIBERS.title: Maximum subscribed object IDs
CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_SUBSCRIBERS.help: Maximum count of object IDs that can be subscribed to simultaneously. A subscribe packet with more IDs is refused.

CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_FRAME_LEN.title: Maximum telemetry frame length (bytes)
CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_FRAME_LEN.help: Maximum byte size of a generated telemetry output packet.

CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_TRACKED.title: Maximum objects reachable from subscriptions
CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_TRACKED.help: Objects telemetry keeps track of: every subscribed object plus everything reachable through its PTR children. Each costs 18 bytes of RAM (12 per entry, table sized 1.5x). Objects past the limit are not sent (ERR_VM_SUB_TRACK_FULL).

arena.description: Every allocation starts on a 4-byte boundary: total_size is the sum of each allocation rounded up to 4.
arena.total_size: sum over every allocation of its size rounded up to the alignment

allocations.description: One per ID space with a nonzero count (obj_cnt, acc_cnt, blk_cnt).
Each name step of an accessor, stored NUL-terminated.

packets.title: Reset
packets.description: Stop the program and unload it: objects, accessors, blocks, heap objects and subscriptions. Leaves the VM empty and stopped.

packets.title: Open program
packets.description: Replace the loaded program with an empty one of this size. Stops a running program first (its retained values are saved). Nothing else can be loaded before it.

total_size.description: Sum of every allocation of the program, see arena.

rules.rule: Open comes first: objects, values, accessors and blocks need an open program.
total_size must cover every allocation (see arena) and fit CONFIG_VM_STORE_MAX_POOL; a failed open leaves the running program untouched.

packets.title: Add objects
packets.description: Create objects: shape, flags and name. Payloads start zeroed; values follow with Set values.

head.description: payload_size is the in-memory size (type memory width x elements).

tails.name: name
tails.description: Not NUL-terminated. Accessors find children by it; retained values are kept by it.

rules.rule: The ID is below obj_cnt.
Each ID is added once.
The type is a real type (not VM_OBJ_NONE).
payload_size is not 0.
payload_size is a multiple of the type's memory width.
A PTR object can't be retentive.
A retentive object needs a name.
All retained values of the program fit CONFIG_VM_RETAIN_MAX_BYTES (2 + per object 4 + name + value).

packets.title: Set values
packets.description: While stopped: initial values, and the children of PTR objects. While running: a runtime write, applied at the start of the next pass.

start_idx.description: Index of the first element written: elements, not bytes.

tails.name: data
tails.description: Elements in wire form, little-endian; a PTR element is its child's u16 object ID.

rules.rule: The object, and every child a PTR record links, exist before the record.
Whole elements inside the object: byte_len is a multiple of the wire width and start_idx + elements <= the object's element count.
While running, PTR objects can't be written (links change only while stopped).
While running, only mutable objects can be written.
While running, block outputs (user-protected) can't be written.

packets.title: Add accessors
packets.description: A path to a value: a root object, then index steps through PTR children down to an element. Block pins read and write through accessors.

root_obj_id.description: May be added after the accessor (it then resolves on every use, slower).

rules.rule: An accessor a REF step names is added before the accessor using it.
idx_len covers exactly the idx_count steps.
Every step kind is a vm_index_kind_e value.
A name step is at most VM_OBJ_NAME_MAX bytes.

packets.title: Add block
packets.description: One block per packet. Blocks run in block ID order, and a block's inputs must exist before it is added.

blk_id.description: Blocks run in ID order: 0 first.

block_idx.description: The app's own number for the block; errors name the block by it.

one_of.description: Runs when any enable is true (OR, a branch merge).
Runs when every enable is true (AND).
Publish a false ENO; downstream blocks skip.
Report the failure and carry on.

eno_obj_id.description: Optional: a mutable B object that receives the block's ENO.

tails.name: in_acc_ids
tails.description: One accessor per input pin; VM_BLOCK_NO_ID leaves the pin unwired (the block uses its state constant).

tails.name: out_obj_ids
tails.description: One object per output pin. The device marks them user-protected: runtime writes to them are refused.

tails.name: en_acc_ids
tails.description: Every one must exist; combined by en_mode.

tails.name: custom_data
tails.description: Initial private state; its layout per block type is in data-structures/vm/blocks/.

rules.rule: Every object and accessor the block names exists before it; the ENO object is a mutable B object.
The block type exists in the palette.
Pin counts within limits, en_mode and on_error known values, and the block passes its type's check (pins, required inputs, state); a rejected block is removed again.

packets.title: Subscribe
packets.description: Replace the telemetry list; 0 records clears it. Everything reachable is sent in full once, then whatever changes (see telemetry).

id.description: VM_OBJ_ID_DYN_BIT set for a heap object.

rules.rule: More IDs than CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_SUBSCRIBERS is refused and nothing changes.

packets.title: Execution control
packets.description: Start, stop, step and reset the program.

vm_wire_index.description: One accessor path step: a u8 kind, then that kind's payload.

acc_id.description: Its value, read on every use, is the position.

telemetry.description: Device to app, on the telemetry stream: [stream][class][packet][u8 count][records]. Frames follow the link's frame size (BLE MTU), capped by CONFIG_VM_SUB_MAX_FRAME_LEN. A lost frame is resent in full the next pass; drop a value for a heap ID that has no describe.

frames.title: Describe
frames.description: Heap objects (ID has VM_OBJ_ID_DYN_BIT), which the app never uploaded: type, size and name. Sent when first seen and when any of them change, always before a value that refers to them.

head.description: payload_size is the in-memory size (type memory width x elements).

tails.name: name
tails.description: Not NUL-terminated. Accessors find children by it; retained values are kept by it.

frames.title: Values
frames.description: Subscribed objects and their PTR children (8 levels) whose value changed since last sent, quiet writes included; everything once after a subscribe. An object bigger than a frame is split over several records (start_idx).

start_idx.description: Index of the first element written: elements, not bytes.

tails.name: data
tails.description: Elements in wire form, little-endian; a PTR element is its child's u16 object ID.
